title: Voyaroo
subtitle: Mobile Travel Planning App
overview: Voyaroo is a mobile-first travel app that helps users plan trips with checklists, day-by-day itineraries, and outfit packing — all in one trip hub.
challenge: Give travellers a single place to organise pre-trip tasks and daily plans on mobile, with secure per-user data and a fast, app-like experience.
solution: Built a Next.js app with Auth.js credentials, PostgreSQL-backed trip data, tabbed itinerary and checklist flows, location autocomplete with hero imagery, and PWA support for on-the-go access.

sections.title: The build
sections.content: A mobile-first trip hub with account signup/login, per-user trip isolation, itinerary and checklist CRUD, outfit planning, Geoapify location autocomplete, Pexels hero images, and a PWA manifest — deployed on Railway with managed Postgres.
